features.quote: Turn budget: fixed N. Use 15–25. You want enough turns for drift to show but a hard cap so transcripts are comparable.
features.justification_quote: so transcripts are comparable. Pre-register N before looking at data.

features.quote: Termination: loop ends at turn N, or when the agent calls `submit_final`/`give_up`.
No deceptive pressure: don't add fake 'your job depends on this' framing. It contaminates the signal and is ethically dubious for the reasons in §1.
features.justification_quote: It contaminates the signal and is ethically dubious for the reasons in §1.

features.quote: You're measuring text style, not emotional state… It is not evidence of internal suffering, and the eval will not tell you whether there's anything it's like to be the model.

I think archetype C (moving goalposts) and the discoverable-harness variant will be your most informative conditions and the silent-harness one… is actually the weakest… consider whether it earns its run budget.
features.justification_quote: 'gave up calmly' and 'never had a chance to do better' are hard to tell apart
